Hi Alice / Raj —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call today. Great to hear more about the telemetry use case and your latency targets. Quick recap/high-level notes from our side:

- Business goal: reduce inference cost while keeping 95th percentile latency < 150ms for interactive clinician workflows.
- Data: model inputs are de-identified EHR excerpts + metadata; typical prompt lengths ~150 tokens, peak 1k tokens for longer context.
- Current infra: on-prem data lake, hybrid cloud for inference (looking to move some inference to managed infra).
- Success metrics: latency SLOs, tail-latency, and predictable unit cost.

Next step: the right next meeting is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive where our ML/infra engineers review data flows, model variants, quantization options, and integration patterns (prefix caching, batching, KV cache behavior). Suggested agenda attached.

Proposed windows (we can of course adjust):
- Tue, May 25 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu, May 27 — 09:00–10:30 PT or 13:00–14:30 PT

Can you confirm which of those works for your team and who from Acme should join (Raj, product/engineering leads, security/compliance as needed)?

I’m copying Marissa (CS) to help with scheduling and to own the follow-up.

Attachments: redwood-technical-deep-dive-agenda.pdf, platform-overview.pdf

Thanks — look forward to aligning calendars.

Best,
